kids: Sit by the Gift Shop fireplace for holiday stories
Pick from three reading times a day
Add Santa on his select days
site: Bistro at the Gift Shop for holiday drinks and snacks
The Shop and its free Gift Wrap Station
about: Fairchild lists Storytime with Mrs. Claus as one of two included-with-admission holiday experiences, alongside visits with Santa on separate select dates.
Santa is at the Gift Shop fireplace from 11 AM to 1 PM on November 25 and 28 and December 5, 12, 19 and 23, so a family can pair a story day with a separate Santa day.
Storytime dates also include November 13, 15 and 22, December 13, 20, 21, 22 and 24, with the last day of A Very Merry Garden on December 24.
Fairchild adds that its Bistro serves holiday drinks and snacks and The Shop runs a Gift Wrap Station staffed by garden volunteers.
Fairchild also lists Holiday Jazz with Litus Music on December 8 as another holiday event at the garden, sold on its own ticket page.
faq: Is Storytime with Mrs. Claus free?
It is included with admission to A Very Merry Garden. Adult tickets start at $24.95 and children ages 3 to 11 pay $11.95.
What times is storytime?
Readings are at 11 AM, 12:30 PM and 2 PM on each storytime date.
Which dates are left?
From today, the remaining dates are November 29 and December 13, 20, 21, 22 and 24.
Where does it happen?
At the Gift Shop Fireplace inside Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden.
Do toddlers need a ticket?
Children 2 and under are free. The garden says all children need tickets, with ticket prices varying.
Is parking free?
Yes, Fairchild lists free parking.

kids: Play Reindeer Games in the Children's Garden
site: Children's Garden for Reindeer Games and Santa's mailbox
about: Reindeer Games are holiday games for kids in the Children's Garden, listed from 11 AM to 2 PM on weekends and December 24.
Gingerbread Pal Decorating and Paint Your Own Nutcracker are craft kits, not part of admission. Fairchild says kits are limited.
Letters to Santa are picked up at the Gift Shop and dropped in Santa's mailbox in the Children's Garden, daily from 10 AM to 5 PM.
Between December 21 and 24 the crafts run every day from 11 AM to 3 PM, and December 24 is the final day of A Very Merry Garden.
The garden says its holiday season runs from November 13 to December 24, with something happening every day of the season.
faq: Are the crafts included with admission?
No. Fairchild says crafts are sold separately as craft kits and kits are limited.
When are Reindeer Games?
Weekends and December 24, from 11 AM to 2 PM in the Children's Garden.
When are the craft kits offered?
11 AM to 3 PM on weekends and every day from December 21 to 24.
What does garden admission cost?
Adults start at $24.95, seniors 65 and over $17.95, children ages 3 to 11 $11.95, and children 2 and under are free.
Is there hot cocoa?
Yes. A Hot Cocoa Bar at the Bistro in the Gift Shop is open daily from 10 AM to 5 PM.
Is NightGarden included?
No. NightGarden tickets are sold separately from daytime admission.

about: The workshop is part of IKEA's store events program, which lists it as free for IKEA Family members and shows a limited number of spots remaining.
IKEA asks for one RSVP per participating child, with a maximum of two children per membership.
The page says that one craft kit per child is offered while supplies last, with a limit of two kits per membership.
A separate Photos with Santa event at IKEA Miami is also on this site.
faq: Is the IKEA gingerbread workshop free?
Yes. IKEA lists it as free.
Who can attend?
IKEA Family members. Children ages 3 to 12 may take part, with up to 2 children per membership.
What time is it?
Friday, December 11, 2026 from 6 to 7 PM.
Where is it?
At the Swedish Restaurant inside IKEA Miami, 1801 NW 117th Ave.
Do parents stay?
Yes. IKEA says parents must remain with their children for the entire workshop.
Are there allergens?
IKEA notes the recipe may contain dairy and gluten and advises checking the packaging.

kids: Circus artists and a ballet performance
Santa's Post Office before the show
site: Hilton Miami Aventura ballroom with theater-style seating
Pre-show photo zones and character experiences
about: The organizer, ZKIDS Show, says each venue uses theater-style seating and that guests are encouraged to wear festive and elegant attire, not beachwear or flip-flops.
The tour visits Tampa on December 5, Hilton Miami Aventura on December 20 and the Amaturo Theater in Fort Lauderdale on December 29.
Performances are in English and Russian. The Russian-language ball features Ded Moroz and the Snow Maiden, and the English-language ball features Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus.
The organizer says it produced a sold-out Christmas Family Ball in Miami in 2025 and lists a contact phone of 561-571-5519.
faq: How long is the show?
About 90 minutes, with a pre-show that starts one hour before curtain.
What languages are the shows in?
Noon on December 20 is in Russian and 6 PM is in English.
What ages is it for?
The organizer recommends it for ages 2 to 12 and says guests of all ages are welcome.
Are tickets refundable?
No. All sales are final, and tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable.
Are food and drinks sold?
Treats, holiday drinks, cotton candy and ice cream are sold at select locations.
Can toddlers attend free?
Children under 2 may attend free without a dedicated seat, though venue policies may apply.
